set.body:
Why: the paired estimators (Plsc/Cca/ReducedRankRegression in Decompositions.scala) have NO R-reference fixtures — only PairedLatentSuite wiring/hand-computed checks. R fixtures exist only for GenPCA (GenPcaRReferenceFixtures). The keystone crossGram refactor rewrites exactly this untested-against-R code; per AGENTS.md, port statistical behavior behind a fixture rather than trusting the port. This is the precondition for the keystone.

Scope: generate reference values from the R ecosystem for small deterministic inputs — PLSC via cross-covariance SVD; CCA via base::cancor / CCA pkg (incl. ridge); RRR (x-to-y) via reduced-rank regression — mirroring the GenPcaRReferenceFixtures convention.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Fixtures added for PLSC, CCA (incl. ridge), and RRR (x-to-y), in the GenPcaRReferenceFixtures style.
- [ ] Assert singular values / canonical correlations, X and Y weights, and scores to an explicit tol via assertEqualsDouble.
- [ ] Suites pass on BOTH platforms: sbt multivarJVM/test and multivarJS/test.
- [ ] Fixture provenance recorded (R script + package versions) alongside the fixtures.
set.title: multivar: build R-parity fixtures for PLSC/CCA/RRR
